tvShow.name: Fauda
tvShow.overview: A top Israeli agent comes out of retirement to hunt for a Palestinian militant he thought he'd killed, setting a chaotic chain of events into motion.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Discovering that Abu Ahmed will attend his brother's wedding, Doron joins his old team for a covert strike, but the plan quickly goes off the rails.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Having tasted action again, Doron pleads with Moreno to rejoin the squad. Meanwhile, Amal determines to martyr herself to avenge her husband.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Abu Ahmed leans on Walid to organize an immediate retaliatory attack, and Doron and Nurit go undercover to close in on their quarry.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Doron sets his sights on recruiting Shirin to his cause. Abu Ahmed risks his life to see his wife, and Moreno sends the team on a daring daytime raid.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: A senior Israeli officer tries to smoke Abu Ahmed out of hiding. Ali fights suspicions of duplicity, and Boaz joins the squad on a risky ambush.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Blamed for the disastrous ambush, Doron takes matters into his own hands and asks the team to join him on a mission to set things right.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: While Moreno tries to track down the rogue team, Doron sinks his hooks deeper into Shirin and takes drastic measures to make a prisoner exchange.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: In the wake of the prisoner exchange, Doron disappears. Walid confronts Abu Ahmed about his tactics, and Moreno's boss threatens to dissolve the team.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: While suspicions grow between Abu Ahmed and his inner circle, Doron poses as a would-be suicide bomber to get perilously close to his target.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Doron gets a surprise visitor while waiting to learn his fate. Abu Ahmed lays out his master plan that could change the region's balance of power.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Doron's bosses give him the go-ahead to carry out his plan, but he discovers the toll his family has paid for his obsession with Abu Ahmed.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: While the team scrambles to give Doron backup on his mission into the lion's den, Walid makes a decision that could change everything.

episodes.name: Episode 1

episodes.name: Episode 2

episodes.name: Episode 4

episodes.name: Episode 10

episodes.name: Episode 11

episodes.name: Episode 12

episodes.name: Episode 8

episodes.name: Episode 1

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of a crisis, Eli mobilizes the unit to join Doron in Belgium. Omar's sister Maya and her husband face unexpected questions.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: The squad presses forward in their search for Gabi, leading to a high-stakes operation in a crowded apartment block. Nurit confesses a secret to Doron.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Upon his return, Doron refuses to believe the worst. Maya begins receiving mysterious messages. Dana, hunting for Adel, puts pressure on a new source.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: In the aftermath of the attacks, Shin Bet mobilizes for revenge while Raphael pitches Doron on a new mission. Sagi reacts to unexpected news.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Doron and Maya begin a long journey. The fallout from Sagi's unauthorized plan to lure Adel out of hiding leaves the team divided and at risk.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: When information leaks to their adversaries in Lebanon, Maya and Doron improvise to reach their destination. Omar faces a painful dilemma.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Dana receives a crucial tip that leads Eli's team to a garage in Jenin. Maya finally reaches Aisha, but finds that her mission isn't over yet.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: A shocking revelation changes the stakes and the plan for Doron. Eli, despite his doubts, signs on for one more mission. Haj moves a valuable asset.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Every second counts as the squad, using Omar's intelligence, races to stay ahead of Haj and recover Gabi before his captors move him out of Lebanon.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: Maya and her family gather in mourning, while Adel moves forward with a plan to strike back. Gabi struggles to process his time as a hostage.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Omar's funeral in Jenin provides a morbid opportunity for Shin Bet as they pursue Adel, sending Doron and his teammates into danger once again.

seasons.overview: Doron and his former squad venture on a mission abroad when new enemies nursing old resentments strike at the heart of Shin Bet's operations.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: What begins as a blood feud (thar) against a Nukhba terrorist who fled to Marseille—gets complicated. The team reunites and is drawn into a dangerous operation to thwart a major incident that comes from an unexpected direction.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Eli and Doron set out to capture another terrorist from the cell in Nahuba. Steve unexpectedly joins them and brings up the lingering tensions between him and Doron from that cursed day.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Doron's actions lead to a head-on clash between the gang, Dana, and the authorities. Gabi, who is summoned to Marseille, tries to mediate between the sides. Hamas activists are pressuring the authorities to apprehend the culprits.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Doron and Eli are trying to blend in with Hamas. Dana is pressuring Naama to take Steve under her wing. Ann is demanding that Masayid join the operation

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Doron, Eli, and the rest of the recruits are kidnapped by a mysterious group on their way to a training camp in Syria. Back in Israel, Gabi and Dana try to figure out who is behind the kidnapping.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Doron and Eli learn the details of the deadly attack that Said and his men are planning. Steve and Anat meet again after two years of being out of touch.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Back to October 7. We are introduced for the first time to the horrific events that shook the lives of Eli, Doron, Steve, and the entire country.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Continuation of the events of October 7. Hagit, Yosef, and the children try to escape from the house infested with terrorists, while Doron, Steve, and Eli are on their way to rescue them.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Said, Ann, and the other terrorists are regrouping to carry out an attack in Israel. Doron is being questioned on suspicion of collaboration. The Shin Bet is launching an operation to locate the terrorists who are already in Israel.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: Said is leading the terrorists toward Israeli territory. Gabi and Steve set out on a rescue mission for Doron, who is still listed as out of contact. Anne is facing the most dramatic decision of her life.

**Fauda - A Riveting Thriller Unraveling the Complexities of Conflict**

As a software engineer juggling a hectic schedule, finding a TV series that can truly captivate my attention is a rare gem. Fauda, the Israeli thriller that has been making waves, managed to not only grab my attention but also keep me on the edge of my seat throughout its gripping narrative.

From the very first episode, Fauda thrusts viewers into the heart of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, offering a nuanced perspective that goes beyond the headlines. The series, which I had the pleasure of managing between my coding sessions, boasts a relentless pace and a storyline that doesn't shy away from the complexities of the region.

One of the standout elements of Fauda is its character development. As someone who appreciates well-crafted narratives, I found myself invested in the lives of the characters, each with their own motives and struggles. Lior Raz, who plays the lead character Doron Kavillio, delivers a stellar performance that adds depth to the series.

The authenticity of Fauda is striking, from the realistic portrayal of military operations to the exploration of the personal toll such conflicts take on individuals. The creators have managed to create a series that feels both thrilling and authentic, offering a rare glimpse into the human side of the conflict.
